svg.aria-label: Overview of the three pipelines for one model. Lane A, z-maps: every voxel gets its own SHASH normative model, which is read at the chronological age; no PCA. Lane B, NormBrainAGE: for each part, the voxels are standardized and reduced by PCA to 100 component scores; every score gets a normal normative model, and a residual correlation R links them; the brain age is the age that maximizes the likelihood of the subject's scores. Lane C, BrainLOSS: the mean of each part gets a normal normative model, which is read at the global brain age from lane B, and as BrainLOSS_age at the chronological age; no PCA. Several models are combined at the end.
